dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to sign up too.

dialogues.speaker: Kinowa
dialogues.text: What a twist! A brave challenger steps up!

dialogues.speaker: "Raging Wind Nanasian"
dialogues.text: Huh? You think you stand a chance against me?

dialogues.speaker: Kinowa
dialogues.text: So many twists and turns today... Who'll be the champion in the end? Let's find out!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The staff mark out the course, and the crowd gathers around to watch. You take your place on the start line...

dialogues.speaker: Kinowa
dialogues.text: Unbelievable! Someone actually beat "Raging Wind Nanasian"!

dialogues.speaker: Kinowa
dialogues.text: #This challenger has claimed today's championship with {M#his}{F#her} lightning-quick moves. Let's hear it for {M#him}{F#her}! Congratulations!

dialogues.speaker: "Raging Wind Nanasian"
dialogues.text: I lost!? No way... This can't be real!

dialogues.speaker: Excited Visitor
dialogues.text: #{M#He}{F#She}'s amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Kinowa
dialogues.text: However! Our longtime fans will be aware that "Raging Wind Nanasian" wasn't the strongest racer to ever grace this track...

dialogues.speaker: Kinowa
dialogues.text: Before him, two absolute local legends ruled the scene. And today — they're back!

dialogues.speaker: Kinowa
dialogues.text: Welcome... "Easy Come"!

dialogues.speaker: Kinowa
dialogues.text: And... "Easy Go"!

dialogues.speaker: Kinowa
dialogues.text: Challenger, these two are the real deal. Even with what we just saw from you... taking them down will be next to impossible.

dialogues.speaker: Kinowa
dialogues.text: Are you ready?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The staff mark out the course, and the crowd gathers around to watch. You take your place on the start line...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Kinowa
dialogues.text: Race over! It's over! What a shocking turn of events!

dialogues.speaker: Kinowa
dialogues.text: #And our ultimate winner is... {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Excited Visitor
dialogues.text: #Whoa! {M#He}{F#She}'s incredible! {M#He}{F#She} actually managed to beat both "Easy Come" and "Easy Go"!

dialogues.speaker: Ecstatic Visitor
dialogues.text: #{M#He}{F#She} was like a golden lightning bolt!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, c'mon! What about this silver lightning bolt? Did nobody see the silver lightning bolt?

dialogues.speaker: "Raging Wind Nanasian"
dialogues.text: A crushing defeat... I doubt I'll ever reach that kind of speed...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't give up.

dialogues.speaker: "Raging Wind Nanasian"
dialogues.text: I... I'll take you as my role model...

dialogues.speaker: Kinowa
dialogues.text: Please accept this grand prize specially prepared for the tournament's champion — you deserve it!

dialogues.speaker: Kinowa
dialogues.text: Your name will go down in the annals of the Easybreeze Speed Champions Tournament forever!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The staff mark out the course, and the crowd gathers around to watch. You take your place on the start line...

dialogues.speaker: Kinowa
dialogues.text: Attention, everyone! The Easybreeze Speed Champions Tournament is about to begin!

dialogues.speaker: Kinowa
dialogues.text: Whoever beats our reigning champ, "Raging Wind Nanasian," our winner for three days straight, will win today's surprise grand prize! Now's your last chance to register for the tournament!

dialogues.speaker: "Raging Wind Nanasian"
dialogues.text: Hmph! No challengers left for me, "Raging Wind Nanasian"? Is that it? Everyone's too scared to lose?

dialogues.speaker: Disheartened Visitor
dialogues.text: *sigh* No one's a match for "Raging Wind Nanasian." Three days in a row! That sort of consistency is hard to beat.

dialogues.speaker: Enthusiastic Yumkasaur
dialogues.text: Awrrrh!

dialogues.speaker: Disheartened Visitor
dialogues.text: Oh? You wanna give it a shot?

dialogues.speaker: "Raging Wind Nanasian"
dialogues.text: Hmph. So we've stooped to letting saurians enter now? Fine! Send out all your beasts, and I'll show you what true speed looks like!

dialogues.speaker: Kinowa
dialogues.text: What a unique tournament this is turning out to be! Can these mighty saurian companions dethrone our three-time winner, "Raging Wind Nanasian"?

dialogues.speaker: Kinowa
dialogues.text: Challenger, are you ready to face "Easy Come" and "Easy Go"?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.
